title: UniPool
shortDescription: Carpooling app for university students. Find people headed your way, split fares, chat in-app, and track rides on a live map.
longDescription: UniPool is a student-first carpooling app built by ACM-VIT to make daily commute and weekend travel easier for university students. Riders post or join trips, match on routes, coordinate in chat, and meet at a pickup pin on the map.

The current release (UniPool 2) is a ground-up redesign of the original 2024 app. It's available on both Android and iOS, ships an in-app chat, native maps with live pickup, and a notification pipeline that actually keeps both sides of the ride in sync.

Under the hood it's the same idea as before - students helping students travel cheaper and safer - but with a cleaner flow, fewer taps, and a UI built for the way people actually plan trips on a campus.

features.title: In-app chat
features.description: 1-on-1 and ride group chats so co-riders can coordinate pickup without leaking phone numbers.

features.title: Live map
features.description: Native map with pickup pins, route preview, and trip status.

features.title: Smart notifications
features.description: Ride requests, accepts, reminders, and status changes pushed across both platforms.

features.title: Redesigned UX
features.description: Rebuilt from scratch over UniPool 1 - fewer taps to post or join a ride.

features.title: Cross-platform
features.description: Built once for iOS and Android via React Native / Expo.

features.title: Auth that just works
features.description: Firebase + Google sign-in, no separate password to forget.

versions.label: UniPool 2
versions.blurb: Total redesign. Chat, native maps, push notifications, smoother onboarding, and an iOS release alongside Android.

versions.label: UniPool 1
versions.blurb: First release. Android-only via Play Store. Picked up decent traction across the campus carpool crowd.
